title: Document Compliance Standard for Wayfare Driver Agreements
content:
This standard of the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product governs the documents a Wayfare driver keeps on file, the expiry notices, document holds and the document-lapse deactivation. The required documents, inspection interval, notice days and hold figures for each level are in the level schedule of required documents.

## Clauses in force

**D1. Acceptance.** Documents are accepted on any agreement that is not closed: an agreement in applied, screening, active, on hold or deactivated status.

**D2. Expiry notices.** Expiry notices go out the level's first-notice days and second-notice days before a required document's expiry date.

**D3. Lifting a document hold.** A document hold is lifted only when every required document is on file and unexpired on the day the hold is lifted; a document expiring later the same day does not count as unexpired. The expiry dates read are the license, insurance, inspection and (where required) permit expiry dates on the agreement.

**D4. Reversal of a document-lapse deactivation.** A deactivation for document lapse is reversed without appeal once every required document is on file and unexpired.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses of this standard are **no longer in force**; each has been superseded by the current basis and is kept here only as a record of the retired wording.

- *Retired:* "On the day after a required document expires without an unexpired replacement on file, the agreement goes on hold with reason expired document." This clause is no longer in force.
- *Retired:* "A document hold still in place the document hold length after the hold start date ends in deactivation for document lapse." This part of the clause is no longer in force; the reversal of a document-lapse deactivation in D4 remains in force.
- *Retired:* "An uploaded document updates the expiry date on the agreement only when it is of a required type and its expiry date is later than the one on file." This clause is no longer in force.

## Lifting a hold: hypothetical cases

| Day the hold would be lifted | Expiry dates of the required documents on file | Lifted? |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-07-01 | all later than 2026-07-01 | yes |
| 2026-07-01 | one expires on 2026-07-01, the rest later | no (a document expiring later the same day is not unexpired) |
| 2026-07-01 | one expired 2026-06-20 | no |

## Notice illustration

On a level with notices at 30 and 7 days, a vehicle registration expiring on 2026-12-15 draws notices on 2026-11-15 and 2026-12-08.
